subject: Altering Modifiers for simulateData in Lavaan

messages.author: d3de871fecddafbb
messages.subject: Altering Modifiers for simulateData in Lavaan
parts:
Hello, 

I am sorry to bother, but I am trying to develop a simulation loop in Lavaan and am having trouble altering the modifiers for the simulation formula. All of the syntax is below: 


N = 10000
ID<-1:10000
x1<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
x2<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
x3<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
x4<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
x5<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
x6<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
c1x1<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
c1x2<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
c1x3<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
x2x1<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
x2x3<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
x2x4<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
x2x5<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)
x2x6<-rnorm(N,.50,.15)

LD1<-data.frame(ID,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,c1x1,c1x2,c1x3,x2x1,x2x3,x2x4,x2x5,x2x6)



E1 <- new.env()
E1Results<-new.env()
 
for(i in 1:N)                                
{

E1$E1F[i]<-
'
F1=~LD1[i,2]*x1+LD1[i,4]*x3+LD1[i,5]*x4+LD1[i,6]*x5+LD1[i,7]*x6

C1~LD1[i,8]*x1+LD1[i,9]*x2+LD1[i,10]*x3

x2~~LD1[i,11]*x1
x2~~LD1[i,12]*x3
x2~~LD1[i,13]*x4
x2~~LD1[i,14]*x5
x2~~LD1[i,15]*x6'
E1$E1D[i]<-simulateData(E1$E1F[i], model.type = "sem",  sample.nobs=10000, seed = 1992)



E1$E1TS[i]<-'
# Measurement Model
F1=~x1+x3+x4+x5+x6
# Path Model
C1~x1+x2+x3
'

E1<-sem(E1$E1TS[i], data=E1D, estimator = "ML")


E1Results$cfi<-c(E1Results$cfi, summary(E1)$FIT[8])
E1Results$tli<-c(E1Results$tli, summary(E1)$FIT[9])
E1Results$rmsea<-c(E1Results$rmsea, summary(E1)$FIT[10])
E1Results$est<-c(E1Results$est, summary(E1)$PE$est)
E1Results$se<-c(E1Results$se, summary(E1)$PE$se)

}


I keep getting the error:

Error in lavaanify(model = model, meanstructure = meanstructure, int.ov.free = int.ov.free,  :
  lavaan ERROR: wrong number of arguments in modifier (LD1,i) of element F1=~x1


Sincerely, 
Ian A. Silver
